emptyBody: Open a PDF to read, edit and export entirely on your Mac.
selectHint: Choose a text or image on the page to edit its properties.
readingHint: On Home, click text to place the caret and type to start editing. Switch to Edit to select images.
structural: Page structure changes; review all affected pages.
fontFallback: Text is locally rebuilt using a fallback font. Review glyphs and spacing before applying.
imageStacking: The moved image is placed above other page content.
ocrReview: A hidden text layer is added. Recognition may contain errors; review extracted text.
batchHint: Replace matching text across this document. All edits are previewed together and applied atomically.
aiHint: Local rule-based planner. Supported: rotate page 2; underline "should"; replace "should" with "must". No document upload.
languageHint: Changes immediately. Your document stays open.
privacy: Documents are processed on this Mac. No cloud services are connected.
conversionHint: Word exports text paragraphs; Excel extracts detected tables or text rows; PowerPoint contains page images. Layout and editability differ from the original. DOCX import reflows text and tables.
pageSizeHint: Changes the page canvas without scaling content. Content outside the canvas can be clipped.
unsavedClose: This document has unsaved changes. Close it?
helpBody: Open a PDF, click text on Home to place the caret, then type to enter Edit automatically. Click the page background, navigate or save to apply automatically. Enter finishes editing; Esc discards the draft. Adjust properties on the right. Pinch the trackpad over the page to zoom; slide two fingers to scroll. ⌘O Open · ⌘S Save a copy · ⌘Z Undo · ⇧⌘Z Redo · ⌘F Search. Protected documents and shared image objects are not supported.
error.invalidPdf: This file is not a readable PDF.
error.encrypted: Encrypted PDFs are not supported in this version.
error.signedPdf: Editing signed PDFs is not supported.
error.sessionLimit: Close a document before opening another.
error.sessionMissing: Document session is no longer available.
error.invalidPage: The selected page does not exist.
error.stalePreview: The document changed. Generate a new preview.
error.staleObject: The selected object changed. Select it again.
error.rotatedText: Rotated text is not editable in this version.
error.textOverflow: The text has reached the page edge and cannot expand further to the right.
error.sharedImage: This image is shared or nested. Editing this occurrence is not yet supported.
error.lastPage: A PDF must contain at least one page.
error.alreadyText: This page already has text; OCR would duplicate it.
error.ocrUnavailable: The local OCR helper is unavailable.
error.outsideRegionChanged: The preview changed content outside the target area. The edit was rejected.
error.unsupportedInstruction: Use one of the supported instruction examples.
error.invalidImage: The image format is not supported.
error.operationFailed: Operation failed. The active document was not changed.
error.engineStopped: The document engine stopped. Restart the application.
editingStrategy: Preserves original text objects when safe, with local reconstruction when needed. Unsafe changes keep your input and show an error.
error.overlappingText: Text overlaps another object. Local reconstruction is unsafe.
error.hiddenText: Editing invisible OCR text layers is not supported yet.
error.unsupportedFontStyle: The fallback CJK font does not support bold or italic. Clear those options.
inlineHint: Type directly; the text box grows to the right with your input. Click elsewhere, navigate or save to apply. Changes can be undone.
inlineKeys: Click the page background to apply · Enter: finish editing · Esc: discard this input
pendingText: Text changes have not been applied
pendingTextHint: Return to the page to preview and apply your changes, or discard this input to continue.
imageDragHint: Drag the image to move. Drag a corner to resize proportionally; hold Shift for free resizing. Release to apply; Esc cancels the drag.
error.imageGeometryUnsupported: This image uses complex drawing, clipping or rotation and cannot be moved, resized or deleted directly. You can try Replace in the properties panel.
error.textExpansionConflict: The expanded text would overlap other content or a table boundary. Your input is retained; adjust the content or position.
error.invalidTextLayout: Use a font size of 3–144 points. Line breaks in this text object are not supported yet.
error.textBoxOverflow: The added text exceeds the specified box. Enlarge the box or shorten the text.
pageSelectionHint: Click thumbnails to toggle pages; Shift-click selects a range. Extraction follows document order. Review rotation and deletion before applying; both can be undone.
keepOnePage: Keep at least one page; deleting all pages is unavailable.
pagesExported: Extracted {{count}} pages and saved a new PDF.
error.pageRangeInvalid: Enter pages or ascending ranges between 1 and {{total}}, separated by commas, e.g. 1-3, 5.
pageDragHint: Drag thumbnails to reorder; selected pages move together. Apply the new order once. You can undo it.
pendingPageOrder: The new order is pending. Apply or reset it before rotating, deleting or extracting pages.
batchOcrHint: Recognize Chinese and English locally and add searchable text. Review the selected pages, then preview and apply the results together.
ocrProgress: Processed {{done}} / {{total}} pages. The original document is unchanged.
ocrCancelling: Cancelling after the current page finishes…
ocrCancelled: OCR cancelled. Temporary results discarded; the original document is unchanged.
ocrLimitHint: Adds searchable text without replacing scan images. Pages with existing text and rotated pages are skipped. No automatic deskew or table reconstruction. Excerpts show only part of each page; review the results.
ocrReadySummary: Recognized {{count}} pages with unchanged appearance. Review the text before applying.
error.ocrNoEligible: No eligible scanned content in the selected pages.
error.ocrNoText: No text was detected. The original document is unchanged.
error.ocrBusy: An OCR task is already running.
error.ocrJobMissing: The OCR task ended. Start a new task.
error.ocrIncomplete: Page recognition is not yet complete.
error.ocrTimeout: Recognition timed out for this page. Batch results were not applied.
ocrPixelsUnchanged: All pages checked pixel by pixel; appearance unchanged.
batchConvertHint: Select PDF files from disk and review the output list. A separate result folder is published only when all files succeed. Cancellation or failure discards this batch’s temporary outputs; sources stay unchanged.
batchScanHint: Run OCR and save scans before converting to Word, Excel or text. Images and PPT accept scans directly. Up to 30 files, 60 MB each, 600 MB total. Reads files from disk, excluding unsaved editor changes.
batchNoFiles: Choose one or more PDF files.
batchSummary: Convert {{count}} files to {{format}}. Numbered filenames avoid duplicate-name collisions.
batchProgress: Converted {{done}} / {{total}} files; results not yet published.
batchCancelling: Cancelling after the current file finishes…
batchCancelled: Cancelled. Temporary outputs removed; source files unchanged.
batchFailed: Batch failed and temporary outputs were discarded. File: {{file}}.
error.batchBusy: Batch conversion is in progress. Wait or cancel.
error.batchFileLimit: Select up to 30 PDFs, totaling no more than 600 MB.
error.batchSelectionRequired: Select PDFs and an output folder.
error.batchSourceChanged: A source changed after selection. Select files again.
error.batchNeedsOcr: The file contains image/vector pages without a text layer. Run OCR and save first.
error.batchWriteFailed: Cannot read or write files. Check disk space and folder permissions.
error.batchDestinationExists: Result directory already exists. Start again to generate a new one.
error.batchRevealFailed: Results are saved, but Finder could not be opened.
batchFormatHint: Word contains text paragraphs; Excel extracts tables or text rows; PPT uses page images; images are exported as ZIP files. Original layout is not guaranteed.
markupHint: Find keywords on selected pages and add PDF annotations while retaining text, fonts and layout. Review the match list and apply once; undo is available. Visual preview is optional.
manageMarkupsHint: Select keyword markups and remove them once. Undo is available. Only annotations created by this feature are listed; original text is retained.
markupPlanSummary: Add {{count}} markup regions; skip {{duplicates}} existing matching markups.
markupSearchHint: Uses PDF text search: ASCII case-insensitive, without whole-word matching. Multi-line matches count as separate regions. Identical markup types at the same region are skipped. OCR scans first. Strikeout marks text; it does not delete it.
markupAllMarked: Selected regions already have this markup type.
markupNoMatches: No matching text in the selected pages. Run OCR first for scans.
markupDeleteSummary: Remove {{count}} keyword markups, retaining original text.
markupEmpty: This document has no keyword markups created by this feature.
markupUnchanged: Original page content verified; text and underlying graphics are unchanged.
error.invalidMarkup: Enter a valid keyword and markup properties.
error.markupLimit: Process up to 2,000 markup regions at a time. Narrow the selection.
allPagesScope: Applies to all {{count}} pages. You can undo this change.
placeTextHint: Click the page to place text · Esc to cancel
placeTextKeys: Type directly. Enter or click outside to finish, Shift+Enter for a new line, Esc to cancel.
